claim: Try a passing sample in one click without changing real workspace data.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; open the landing action; edit, reset, and leave the demo; assert only demo-prefixed session keys exist

claim: The browser checker sends no trace data, sets no cookies, and loads no analytics or third-party runtime resources.
where: landing facts, playground, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter a marker in both editors; assert zero run-time requests, same-origin resources, no cookies, and no analytics or remote-font elements

claim: The package matcher runs in the browser demo without an account or setup.
where: landing facts, playground, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /?demo=1, assert direct isolated demo entry without auth fields, load wrong-order sample, and observe the matcher failure

claim: The same fixture and events return the same verdict.
sandbox: fresh demo; run the unchanged passing fixture twice and compare the complete rendered trace

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo/, wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and run the fixture

claim: Fixtures check required calls, counts, partial ordering, forbidden actions, and unmatched events; retry faults repeat after reset.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:matcher-rules
sandbox: one fixed fixture; assert a passing trace and missing, wrong-order, forbidden, and unexpected mutations

claim: The recorder stores scrubber output instead of raw tool arguments and omits unscrubbed results.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:recorder-scrubbing
sandbox: record an argument containing a unique secret and assert the saved trace contains only the selected scrubbed field

claim: The MIT package ships ESM, CommonJS, TypeScript declarations, a JSON Schema, zero runtime dependencies, and no network client.
where: landing first screen, privacy page, README
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:package-contract
sandbox: clean built package; import ESM and CommonJS and inspect declarations, schema, license, and dependency metadata

claim: The CLI emits JSON and returns exit codes 0, 1, and 2 for pass, mismatch, and invalid input.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:cli-contract
sandbox: temporary fixture files; execute the built CLI with passing, mismatching, and malformed event data

claim: The CLI prints a line for each observed event and the exact mismatch.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:cli-readable-trace
sandbox: temporary fixture files; run a missing-call trace and assert the event row and exact missing-action explanation

claim: The recorder, matcher, fault injector, and trace renderer can be imported and run independently.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:public-functions
sandbox: built ESM package; import and execute each of the four public functions

claim: The package requires Node.js 20 or newer.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:node-requirement
sandbox: inspect the package engine declaration and execute the built CLI under the supported test runtime

claim: Expected actions can match a tool, an optional phase, and a JSON subset of scrubbed arguments.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:selector-matching
sandbox: fixed result event with nested arguments; assert the matching subset passes and a different subset fails

claim: An expected action without count must match exactly once.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:default-count
sandbox: one fixture without count; assert zero and two matches fail while one match passes

claim: Result and error bookkeeping is ignored by default when every expectation targets calls.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:call-bookkeeping
sandbox: strict call-only fixture; append result and error events and assert the fixture still passes

claim: The recorder requires an argument scrubber before it can record events.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:scrubber-required
sandbox: construct recorders with missing options and missing scrubArgs; assert both fail before recording

claim: The CLI never prompts for input.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:cli-no-prompt
sandbox: temporary fixture files; run the CLI with stdin closed and a two-second timeout; assert it terminates with the documented mismatch
